title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1631: Mixed blood (2)

section.p: “Impudent!”
Great Yuan King roared and attacked with his bow again.

Powerful shockwaves continued rocking the formation. Finally, Heavenly Seal King coughed a mouthful of blood from the intense energy undulations inside the formation. He hurriedly released his characters to stabilize the energy around him. Then, he roared, “Hurry up with the outer formation! At this rate, this formation won’t last much longer!”
The two were simply too strong.
Great Ming King was there to maintain the formation, but he could only prevent it from being instantly destroyed. Nothing else. In fact, the formation would have collapsed long ago without him.
Su Yu did not seem to care about anything else apart from his battle with Great Yuan King.
Destruction.
Rampage.
Death.

He had to kill at least one of Great Yuan King’s tri-life bodies. But if that wasn’t possible, he wouldn’t mind killing Great Yuan King for real. There was no point in holding back. Great Yuan King had completely gone mad. Thus, he no longer cared about the well-being of Great Yuan King.

He couldn’t keep using death qi for too long lest he accidentally open a death tunnel here. That might get extremely dangerous since this was the Human Realm. He would only open one during a moment of desperation to flee for his life, not now.

With death qi and the Heaven Gate, his strength surged massively, reaching the level of over a hundred million acupoints. Every punch of his was comparable to the attack of an eighth or ninth-degree Eternal.

As a proper Invincible, Great Yuan King was proficient in the power of laws. Alas, the many small doors in the formation was limiting what he could do. Each time his River of Time came into contact with one of these doors, it would stop moving for a short moment. The formation might be incomplete, but it was already working against Great Yuan King.
After stopping Great Yuan King with the formation yet again, Su Yu rushed forth with surging death qi. He had learned how to handle the power of laws with characters from Wan Tiansheng.

With the pass character and the Time technique, he vanished before reappearing right in front of Great Yuan King. Then, he kicked out with the vibrate character active, stacking his kick countless times.

Intense vibrational forces assaulted Great Yuan King’s spear, threatening to break the spear apart. The two continued fighting without saying anything as the intensity of their fight continued rising.
With a roar, Great Yuan King landed dozens of punches on Su Yu, breaking his sternum. At the same time, Su Yu clawed at Great Yuan King’s arms, tearing through flesh, veins, and bones.
As the two fought like wild beasts, the surrounding Invincibles coughed blood nonstop while trying to contain their fight.
They all cursed endlessly at the two lunatics.
“Old Zhou, we can’t wait any longer!” Great Xia King solemnly said, “The worst might happen if we allow this to continue!”
Great Zhou King nodded. He rushed forward and roared, “Heavenly Seal, keep managing the formation. I will supply you with source qi and willpower. Do not resist the inflow.”
“This…”
“Stop wasting time! Control both of them! Don’t allow them to kill each other!”
“Fine…”
Heavenly Seal King did not protest and accepted Great Zhou King’s source qi and willpower. Instantly, he took direct control over several small doors.
At the same time, Great Xia King flew toward Silk Destroying King and shouted, “Silk, use my strength!”
Silk Destroying King said, “I haven’t even used my full strength. Are you looking down on me? Go help Zhou Tianyuan instead.”
Right after saying that, source qi roared inside his body.
His vitality surged.
The aura of a sixth-degree Eternal erupted from the body. It had always been rumored that he was only a fifth-degree Eternal, but he was displaying more than that level of strength.
Abruptly, the female furball’s voice rang out in Su Yu’s mind, “Found it. Silk Destroying King…has the bloodline of Control King.”
Su Yu was alarmed.
Silk Destroying King!
So it was really him!
“Damn it!”
Su Yu cursed inwardly. Why must it be Silk Destroying King? He had been focusing on both Silk Destroying King and Heavenly Seal King.
And finally, Silk Destroying King’s bloodline was exposed.
It was him.

Su Yu had mixed feelings about this. No matter what, he had learned Silk Destroying King’s Time technique. But Silk Destroying King was actually…a descendant of Control King. As Silk Destroying King released his real strength, he instantly calmed the entire formation down with the power of time.
Not far away, Great Zhou King frowned slightly and asked, “When did you reach the sixth degree?”
“Hahaha! Surprise! Back when I killed the Silkwyrm King, my mental state relaxed. That state of relaxation helped me break through to the next level.”

Great Zhou King nodded and said nothing else. He continued sending source qi and willpower toward Heavenly Seal King. With his support, Heavenly Seal King was finally able to stabilize his part in the formation.
Apart from Heavenly Seal King and Silk Destroying King, Junior Zhou King was handling another part of the formation. He seemed to be doing decently as well.
“Found him.”
Having found his target, Su Yu stopped wasting time. With a roar, he shot forth. At the same time, he slowed Great Yuan King down with his slow character.
Dozens of punches followed, soaking Great Yuan King with blood and flooding his body with death qi. Great Yuan King counterattacked with his spear, leaving numerous wounds on Su Yu’s body as well.

After attacking with his spear, Great Yuan King pulled back and continued attacking with his bow, leaving even more wounds on Su Yu’s body. Ignoring all his wounds, Su Yu roared and rushed forward again. Slowly, he shifted the battle in Silk Destroying King’s direction.
Noticing their slow approach, Silk Destroying King cursed, “Don’t fight here! Do it elsewhere!”
Damn it! Why were they fighting at his part of the formation? He was only at the sixth degree while the two were seventh degree in combat strength.

Naturally, Su Yu ignored him and continued fighting like he had gone mad. In fact, the death qi around him was so thick that he was starting to look like an actual death sovereign. Great Yuan King was just as mad as he continued roaring while attacking violently.
The intense battle continued.

Finally, Great Yuan King’s three bodies started showing signs of splitting from each other. With a furious roar, he forcefully bound all three together again and said, “Don’t even dream of killing me! You are unworthy!”
“Die!”
Su Yu shouted coldly. Just then, the Heaven Gate on his forehead opened fully. Even more death qi leaked out of his body. Below him, a translucent death tunnel started taking form.
“Die!”

The death character carried a large amount of death qi before transforming into a door and pressing down on Great Yuan King. At the same time, over a hundred doors from around them moved with a wave of Su Yu’s arm, sealing Great Yuan King’s River of Time.
That combination managed to completely freeze Great Yuan King for a split second. That was enough for Su Yu to draw near and throw a punch.
A punch with the strength of over a hundred million acupoints.
Alarmed shouts rang out everywhere.
“King!”
The prefect of Great Yuan, a Pseudo Invincible, paled.
Great Yuan King was blasted apart. Intense shockwaves swept out in all directions. The cursing Silk Destroying King wanted to escape the shockwaves, but it was too late.

Struck by the relentless shockwaves, Silk Destroying King coughed a mouthful of blood. With a wave of his arm, Su Yu collected the flesh and blood around him, including the mouthful of blood spat out by Silk Destroying King. Then, the Mark of Civilization devoured everything.
Not far away, a River of Time trembled. Great Yuan King was about to return in a tri-life body.
Great Xia King roared, “Stop!”
Great Yuan King had been defeated.
He had lost a body to Su Yu.
All around the academy, the jaws of the numerous myriad race guests dropped.
They were fighting for real!
Great Yuan King had lost a tri-life body!
This was definitely a fight to the death.

Nobody would use the tri-life body of a seventh-degree Eternal as the prop of an act. Great Yuan King was one of the pillars of humanity, yet Su Yu had destroyed his tri-life body publicly. At this rate, he might even die.
This couldn’t be an act.
It was simply pointless to push a performance that far.

After all, no race would dare to trust Great Yuan King even after such a battle. They wouldn’t give him the same benefits he could get by staying with humanity. There was no need for them to sacrifice so much just to install a spy among the myriad races.

Finally, someone noticed something. With a sigh, they said, “An issue must have really arisen in Great Yuan King’s tri-life bodies. He has lost control. He was really trying to kill Su Yu. In his fury, Su Yu tried to kill Great Yuan King as well.”

Finally, realization dawned on many in the crowd. This whole thing was a mere accident. Great Yuan King had simply lost control while Su Yu was simply someone with a bad temper. It was truly impressive how he had destroyed a tri-life body of Great Yuan King with only physical strength and a formation capable of somewhat affecting the power of time.
After losing a body, there was no way Great Yuan King could continue being a match for Su Yu. His remaining bodies would lose.
“King!”
“Father!”
The people of Great Yuan exclaimed in alarm.
The prefect of Great Yuan shouted in panic, “Su Yu, don’t kill my father! You have Great Yuan’s vote! We will support your ascension to the leadership of the new holy land! Great Zhou King…please…”
At that, Great Zhou King shouted coldly, “Stop! Su Yu, Great Yuan King did not intend that. It was an accident.”

Su Yu looked at them coldly and asked, “What is this? Are you trying to bully me with numbers? Did you not hear what I said earlier? I will kill him. Are you trying to start a war with the holy cities after luring me inside the Human Realm alone?”
Taking a mayor’s medallion out, he said, “Interfere and face the wrath of the thirty-six guardians. How dare Great Yuan King provoke me? He must die. Nobody can stop me.”

Numerous people paled upon hearing that. Finally, they recalled that Su Yu was not alone. If they dared to interfere, he might really send a message through the medallion…and trigger a war between humanity and the ancient cities.

The consequences of such an event were too horrible for many to contemplate. Some of the Invincibles in the area were left helpless. Some had the urge to start cursing loudly. The conference was supposed to be the start of something good. How did it devolve into something like this?
A fight to the death between Great Yuan King and Su Yu. Interfering would result in grave consequences. But not interfering would result in Great Yuan King’s death.
If a human Invincible was killed in their presence…

They would have no choice but to fight. In that case, wouldn’t fighting Su Yu before Great Yuan King died be the better option? This placed Great Xia King and some other Invincibles in a difficult place.
What should they do?

Slowly, Great Yuan King emerged from his River of Time. Inside the Mark of Civilization, the female furball gave the gathered blood a lick and said, “Yes, this is the bloodline of Control King…mixed with something…That something might be the bloodline of a different expert. A mixed bloodline. Silk Destroying King’s proficiency of time must have originated from Control King. After all, Control King was proficient in sealing, and often, the art of sealing was inseparable from the power of time.”
Silk Destroying King!
So it was really him!

Su Yu even gave Silk Destroying King another chance by deliberately injuring Silk Destroying King to double-check. Since he was gathering all the flesh and blood in the area, it wouldn’t look too suspicious for him to gather some of Silk Destroying King’s blood as well.
Alas, it was now confirmed.
It was Silk Destroying King.
Su Yu had mixed feelings about this. He couldn’t be considered close to Silk Destroying King, but that was someone whose technique he had learned long ago.
Yet that same person was also the traitor who had caused Ye Batian’s death.
